events_chronological: Renn and his wife Isa spend fifty subjective years together on the deep level, building a world out of memory.
To get Isa to wake up, Renn plants in her mind the idea that her world is not real.
The idea keeps growing after they wake; Isa throws herself from a hotel window and frames Renn for her murder.
Renn flees the country and works as an extractor for hire, unable to go home to his children.
Renn and Dax run an extraction on the energy magnate Halvard that collapses when Isa's projection intervenes.
Halvard, impressed rather than angry, hires Renn to plant an idea in his rival's heir Theo Brandt in exchange for having his record cleared.
Renn assembles the chemist Sabir, the forger Quill and the student architect Sable, whom his father-in-law Hoyt points him to at the university.
Sable learns to build dream architecture and finds the memory prison in Renn's mind where the projection of Isa lives.
Theo's father dies and the team books the son onto a ten-hour flight home.
On the first level Sabir drives the van through rain-soaked streets while Theo's militarised subconscious attacks and Halvard is shot.
On the second level Quill impersonates Theo's godfather Crale in a hotel to turn Theo against him.
On the third level the team assault a snow fortress where Quill sets charges and Theo is meant to reach his father's safe.
Isa's projection shoots Theo dead inside the fortress, and Renn and Sable go down to the deep level to bring him back.
Renn admits to the projection that he was the one who planted the idea that killed his wife.
Renn refuses the projection's offer to stay and lets her go.
Sable pushes Theo off a balcony to wake him, and he opens his father's safe to find the will and the paper pinwheel.
Sabir's van hits the water, Dax's lift charge fires and Quill blows the fortress, and the jolts cascade back up through the levels.
Renn stays behind on the deep level to search for the aged Halvard.
Renn washes up on a shore and is carried to a castle where Halvard is an old man, and the two remind each other of their bargain and shoot themselves awake.
Everyone wakes on the plane, Halvard makes the phone call, Renn is waved through immigration and comes home to his children as the spinning top wobbles on the table.
nonlinear_category_reason: The job holds 13 of 16 scenes and runs forward, with the marriage material inserted from earlier and released in pieces.
syuzhet_notes: Told-order bullet 1 is a flash-forward to the penultimate scene, which the narrative returns to at bullet 19. Told-order bullets 7, 8 and 14 are flashbacks into the protagonist's marriage, released in pieces as the young architect pries them out of him, with the worst of it - that he planted the idea that killed his wife - withheld until the deepest level. From bullet 10 onwards the film runs four nested dream levels at once at wildly different rates.
fabula_notes: The dream levels are simultaneous rather than sequential and time dilates roughly twentyfold at each level down, so laying bullets 10-17 out as one chronological line flattens four clocks running together. Whether the closing scene is real is deliberately left open by the still-spinning top.

events.content: Down where a night lasts decades they put up streets out of everything either of them remembers, and grow old in them together while their bodies lie a few hours away.

Renn: she does not want to leave

events.content: To get her to come up he goes into the locked part of her and turns one small thought over: that none of this is real. It works, and it does not stop working.

Renn: an idea can be made to grow in someone else
reader: he is the author of what happens to her next

events.content: Back in the world the thought keeps growing until she steps off a hotel ledge, having first arranged the papers so that it will look as though he pushed her.

Renn: she is dead and he is accused
reader: her death is a consequence of his own technique

questions.q6: why did she stop believing her world was real?

events.content: He leaves the country between flights and sells the only skill he has to people who want what is in other people's heads. The children stay where they are.

reader: intro:Dax
he is a fugitive who cannot go home

questions.q4: why can he not simply go home?

events.content: The extraction is going cleanly until a woman who should not be in the dream walks through it and puts a bullet where it does the most damage.
events.location: a dreamed apartment above a riot

Halvard: these two are good enough to be useful
reader: intro:Halvard
something of his own keeps wrecking his work

questions.q1: why is a man this good selling it by the job?
questions.q2: who is the woman who keeps walking into his work?

events.content: Rather than have them killed he offers them a harder job on the other side of the table, and the one thing that would make it worth taking: a cleared record and a way home.

Renn: there is a route back to his children
reader: what he is being paid in, and why he cannot refuse

questions.q3: what could anyone offer him that is worth this?

events.content: A chemist who can hold four people under, a forger who can wear another man's face, and a student his father-in-law puts in front of him because she is better than he is.

events.content: Learning to fold a city, she wanders into the part of his mind he keeps as an apartment building of preserved rooms, and finds the woman he keeps locked in it.
events.location: a dreamed lift and a corridor of rooms

Sable: he keeps his dead wife in his own architecture
reader: the projection is not an accident; it is housed

questions.q5: what is he keeping locked in his own architecture?

events.content: The father dies on schedule and the son flies home with the body. Ten hours in the air, and every seat around him bought.
events.location: an airport and a long-haul cabin

reader: intro:Theo
the whole operation has ten hours to run

questions.q9: how do they intend to turn the son against his father's legacy?

events.content: Rain, a bridge, and a subconscious that has been trained to fight back. The van takes fire from the first minute and the client takes a round in the chest.

Renn: the mark has been trained against extraction
reader: the first level is already going wrong

questions.q11: how does anyone get back up from three levels down?

events.content: Wearing the godfather's face in a corridor of tilting rooms, he tells the son that the old man was working against his father, and lets him draw the conclusion himself.

Theo: the man he trusts may have betrayed his father
reader: intro:Crale
the idea is being built in stages, not stated

events.content: White slopes, a hospital dug into rock, charges on the walls, and somewhere inside it a safe the son has to open himself.

reader: the last level, and what it is for

questions.q10: what is the son meant to find in the safe?

events.content: She walks out of the snow into the room where it was all supposed to conclude and shoots the mark through the chest, and there is only one place left to follow him to.

reader: the job now requires going all the way down

questions.q7: why does the projection want the job to fail?

events.content: Standing in the rooms he built for her, he says it out loud for the first time to the thing that is not her: the thought that killed her was his, and he put it there.

reader: the fact the telling has withheld from the first minute

events.content: She offers him the rest of it, all of it, for good. He tells her she is not enough because she is only what he could remember, and lets her go.

reader: the private job is finished before the paid one is

events.content: She puts him off a balcony to send him up a level, and in the fortress he turns the dial and finds the will, and beside it a paper toy from a childhood he had stopped believing in.

Theo: his father wanted him to be his own man
reader: the idea has taken, and it feels to him like his own

events.content: A van leaves a bridge, a lift drops on a charge, a mountain comes apart, and the three jolts arrive in the right order all the way up the stack.

reader: the mechanism, running to time for once

events.content: He lets the others go up without him and turns back into the endless water to look for an old man who has been down there for a subjective lifetime.

reader: he has one more errand and no clock left

events.content: Surf, then a rifle at his neck, then a long stone room where a very old man is waiting. They remind each other what they agreed, and take the short way up.
events.location: a shore and a castle on the deep level

reader: the image the telling opened on, now placed and explained

questions.q8: who is the old man on the shore, and what binds them?

events.content: Everyone surfaces in the cabin as the wheels touch. A phone call is made, a passport is stamped without comment, and two children turn round in a garden while a small metal top goes on turning behind him.
events.location: the cabin, an airport, a house

reader: he gets what he was paid in, and the telling declines to say whether it is real

edges.on: one man letting go of his dead wife while another accepts what his father wanted
the same built streets, lived in and then confessed to
